2609.03535.title: Feature Reconfiguration With Visual Prior for Medical Lesion Segmentation
2609.03535.paper_summary: Lesion segmentation in medical images plays a critical role in clinical diagnosis and treatment planning. Despite significant advances, lesion segmentation remains challenging due to two major factors: (1) complex background interference; (2) diverse lesion morphology. Existing encoder-decoder based methods mainly focus on enhancing feature extraction or redesigning decoding strategies. However, they lack early prior guidance and feature reconfiguration during the encoding stage, limiting their effectiveness in handling these challenges. To address these limitations, we propose FreNet, a feature reconfiguration framework with visual priors, which performs pixel-level reconfiguration before encoding and feature-level reconfiguration during encoding for precise medical lesion segmentation. To suppress background responses, we propose an Implicit Prior Neural Network (IPNN), which models a continuous spatial field and leverages visual prior from SAM to reconfigure input image before encoding stage. To better handle diverse lesion morphology, we design a Dual-domain Feature Reconfiguration (DFR) module to progressively reconfigure backbone features during encoding stage. Within DFR, the Frequency Decoupling Module (FDM) decouples backbone features in frequency domain to enhance foreground-background discriminability, while the Spatial Localization Module (SLM) spatially relocates and improving spatial stability after frequency decoupling. Extensive experiments on 9 medical image segmentation benchmarks across three imaging modalities demonstrate that FreNet significantly outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods. On the challenging ETIS dataset, our method achieves Dice improvements of 5.0% over SOTA method and 7.2% over SAM.
2609.03535.paper_summary_zh: 醫學影像中的病變分割在臨床診斷和治療計劃中扮演著關鍵角色。儘管取得了重大進展，病變分割仍然面臨兩個主要挑戰：(1) 複雜的背景干擾；(2) 多樣的病變形態。現有的基於編碼器-解碼器的方法主要集中在增強特徵提取或重新設計解碼策略。然而，它們在編碼階段缺乏早期的先驗指導和特徵重新配置，限制了它們在處理這些挑戰時的有效性。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了FreNet，一個具有視覺先驗的特徵重新配置框架，該框架在編碼之前進行像素級的重新配置，並在編碼過程中進行特徵級的重新配置，以實現精確的醫學病變分割。為了抑制背景響應，我們提出了一種隱式先驗神經網絡（IPNN），該網絡建模連續的空間場，並利用來自SAM的視覺先驗在編碼階段之前對輸入圖像進行重新配置。為了更好地處理多樣的病變形態，我們設計了一個雙域特徵重新配置（DFR）模塊，以在編碼階段逐步重新配置骨幹特徵。在DFR中，頻率解耦模塊（FDM）在頻率域中解耦骨幹特徵，以增強前景-背景的可分辨性，而空間定位模塊（SLM）在頻率解耦後進行空間重定位並改善空間穩定性。在三種成像模式下對9個醫學影像分割基準的廣泛實驗表明，FreNet顯著超越了最先進的（SOTA）方法。在具有挑戰性的ETIS數據集上，我們的方法相較於SOTA方法實現了5.0%的Dice改進，並比SAM提高了7.2%。
